recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to CDSHooksRequestGroup should be handled in the Using FHIR Clinical Reasoning with CDS Hooks IG, not in FHIR core.
issue_request: FHIR-18244 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by the CDS work group and requested a RequestGroup profile for mapping CDS Hooks responses, with the approved resolution to add CDSHooksRequestGroup.
initial_application: Commit 38e5905c42 applied the issue by adding source/requestgroup/requestgroup-cdshooks-spreadsheet.xml as the CDSHooksRequestGroup profile. Later source-rework history deleted that legacy RequestGroup spreadsheet as RequestGroup was retired from current core and replaced by RequestOrchestration.
additional_context: FHIR-48393 and FHIR-53085 are later Applied/Persuasive R6 decisions that remove CDS profiles from the base specification and move CDS-on-FHIR page content, CDS Hooks profiles, and mapping concept maps to the Using FHIR Clinical Reasoning with CDS Hooks IG. Current source/fhir.ini has RequestOrchestration active, RequestGroup removed, and no active CDSHooksRequestGroup/CDSHooksRequestOrchestration profile entry. The current clinicalreasoning-cds-on-fhir page is informative and points to the external IG, and the HL7/cds-hooks-clinical-reasoning repository contains StructureDefinition-cdshooksrequestgroup.json.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing a core CDSHooksRequestGroup or CDSHooksRequestOrchestration profile would contradict the later R6 decisions that intentionally moved this content out of core.

related_jiras.note: R6 CDS decision to remove profiles from the base specification, including CDS Hooks-related profile families.
